title: The dance of the forces
blurb: Why most things on a chart of mass and size fall on one diagonal: electromagnetism against gravity, then the strong force and fusion, then the weak force, from a stick to a neutron star.

segments.to: purely by the force of gravity.

_note: The forces Short from the new take (rec74, 2026-11-17), the author: 'take out just the dance of the forces part and make a short video'. The section runs 4:00 in the long video, so the Short leaves out what a Short can lose to fit under 3:00: the chemical bonds and their animation, gravity's reach and the round worlds, 'Get massive enough…', the small stars' end. The old Short (short-l2-dance-of-the-forces, rec58) stays beside it to compare.
